newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Senate to vote on long-awaited telecom law.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Senate to vote on long-awaited telecom law.

text.p: The Brazilian Senate was scheduled to vote Thursday morning on a bill regulating the opening up of the telecommunications sector to private competition, an official said.
The Congress official said the session opened formally at 0900 local/1200 GMT and balloting was likely to take place later in the morning.
The long-awaited bill, known as the General Telecommunications Law, was passed by three Senate committees in a joint session Tuesday.
It would pave the way for the privatization of federally-owned telecommunications giant Telebras and establish a regulator for the industry. The ballot on the Senate floor is the last hurdle.
